capabilities: detect tags containing non-Latin letters in the editing view
add a generic class (cm-tag-non-latin) and a per-tag class to their span elements
preserve standard classes and styling for Latin tags
inject cm-hashtag classes so third-party styling plugins recognize the tags
support nested tags by removing slashes from class names
disambiguation: It does not translate, rename, or otherwise process tags; it only injects CSS classes so non-Latin tags can be styled.
extras: Classes are injected only in the Editing view; the README includes developer-oriented DOM structure details and notes unit tests written with Vitest.
problem: Obsidian's tag styling hooks only cover Latin tags, so tags with Cyrillic, hieroglyphs, or diacritics cannot be targeted with CSS or by styling plugins.

relations.evidence: configure their styling using third-party plugins (such as Colored Tags Wrangler)

summary: Adds CSS classes to tags containing non-Latin letters in the editor, so they can be styled with CSS snippets.
